facts.fact: Public head shorthand supplies scalar HEAD to prepareRoute without isFastify; extended route supplies options without isFastify. all supplies this.supportedMethods, whose value is not established by this span.

prepareRoute copies options then overrides method/url/path/handler and calls route. route shallow-copies options then overwrites opts.isGeneratedHeadRoute with isFastify === true. User options.isGeneratedHeadRoute alone cannot survive that assignment on selected public route path.

Scalar method and each array element are normalized through string check, uppercase and supported-set check. Selected array remains an array; it is not collapsed to scalar HEAD. Empty array bypasses loop: no guarantee of usable route registration follows.

Shallow copy retains method array reference; indexed normalization writes into that array. No deep-copy or global nonmutation guarantee. headOpts is a shallow original-options copy conditional on shouldExposeHead and isGetRoute.

After normalization, prefixed root branch uses generated flag, not method equality. Explicit HEAD shorthand can take branch; selected generated HEAD recursive call supplies isFastify true and skips it. Slash options and ignore flags still govern local registrations.

addNewRoute mutates opts URL fields, runs onRoute hooks on non-prefixing branch before router.on. Actual router behavior/possible hook mutations remain outside selected lexical proof. Generated HEAD call occurs only under shouldExposeHead && isGetRoute && !isHeadRoute && !hasHEADHandler, with scalar HEAD, local path and isFastify true.

reachability.case: explicit public head shorthand, valid handler/prefix conditions
